name: IMO-AnswerBench
description: IMO-AnswerBench is a benchmark for evaluating mathematical reasoning capabilities on International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO) problems, focusing on answer generation and verification.
evaluation_method: accuracy (answer correctness verified by symbolic checkers or human evaluation)
typical_sota_score: ~20–50% (top reasoning models as of 2025; humans with training ~60–80%)
reputation: Tests models on the hardest tier of mathematical competition problems; IMO problems are considered among the most difficult mathematics questions in the world; only frontier reasoning models achieve non-trivial scores
notes: Focused on IMO problems with computable numerical or constructive answers, excluding pure proof problems that require formal verification. Provides a cleaner evaluation signal than full proof tasks. Distinct from FrontierMath and USAMO25 in its focus on Olympiad-level competition mathematics.
